title: Returning to Exercise After Childbirth — Gradual, Safe and Individual

hook.en: New mothers get conflicting advice about when and how to exercise again. Learn a safe, stepwise plan, how to check the abdominal wall and pelvic floor and which signs mean wait.
hook.ur: Nai mayon ko kab aur kaise dobara exercise karni hai is par mukhtalif mashware milte hain. Mehfooz, marhale war plan, pait ki deewar aur pelvic floor check karna aur woh nishaniyan seekhein jin ka matlab hai intezaar karein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll assess a postnatal woman, advise on early walking and pelvic floor work, progress strength and impact in stages, and handle abdominal separation, scars and leaking with confidence.
goal.ur: End tak aap postnatal aurat ki assessment karenge, jaldi chalne aur pelvic floor ke kaam par mashwara denge, taaqat aur impact marhalon mein barhayenge, aur pait ki alag hone, scar aur leaking ko aitemad se sambhalenge.

text.en: Most women can start **gentle movement soon after birth**: walking, breathing exercises and pelvic floor work, as soon as they feel able. A **postnatal check at about six weeks** is common, but **returning to higher-impact exercise** such as running depends on **readiness**, not on a date: no leaking, heaviness or pain, good strength and the ability to do the task well. Many women feel ready from about **three months**, some later. Caesarean birth, tears and breastfeeding change the plan.
text.ur: Zyada tar khawateen **paidaish ke jaldi baad halki harkat** shuru kar sakti hain: chalna, saans ki exercises aur pelvic floor ka kaam, jaise hi woh taiyar mehsoos karein. Takreeban **chhe haftay par postnatal check** aam hai, magar **zyada impact wali exercise** maslan daurna **taiyari** par munhasir hai, tareekh par nahi: leaking, bojh ya dard nahi, achhi taaqat aur kaam ko achhi tarah karne ki salahiyat. Bohat si khawateen takreeban **teen mahine** se taiyar mehsoos karti hain, kuch baad mein. Caesarean paidaish, tears aur doodh pilana plan badal dete hain.

text.en: Think of the body after birth as **a house after major renovation**. You do not hang heavy shelves the day the builders leave: you check the walls, repair as needed and add weight in stages. Strength, the pelvic floor and the abdominal wall are the walls; the plan is to test and load them in steps.
text.ur: Paidaish ke baad jism ko **bari marammat ke baad ghar** samjhein. Mazdoor jane ke din bhaari shelves nahi lagate: deewarein dekhte hain, zaroorat ho to theek karte hain aur marhalon mein wazan daalte hain. Taaqat, pelvic floor aur pait ki deewar deewarein hain; plan unhein qadam qadam par test aur load karna hai.

title.ur: Paidaish ke baad exercise par wapsi

steps.title: Check and screen
steps.detail: Ask about the birth (vaginal, caesarean, tears), bleeding, leaking, heaviness, pain, sleep and breastfeeding. Screen for red flags and ask what exercise the woman wants to do. || Check aur screen karein

steps.title: Start gently
steps.detail: Begin with walking, deep breathing with a gentle abdominal and pelvic floor connection, and posture and lifting advice. Avoid heavy lifting and straining in the early weeks, especially after a caesarean. || Narmi se shuru karein

steps.title: Rebuild strength
steps.detail: Add pelvic floor and deep core training, glutes, legs, back and arms with progressive resistance over several weeks. Check the abdominal midline: a gap is common and usually narrows, and a good strength plan matters more than the width. || Taaqat dobara banayein

steps.title: Return to impact
steps.detail: Before running or jumping, check she can do a single-leg squat, hop on the spot and run on the spot without leaking, heaviness, pain or doming of the abdomen. Add short run-walk intervals and build slowly. || Impact par wapsi

question.en: What decides when a woman can return to running?
question.ur: Aurat daurna kab shuru kar sakti hai yeh kya tay karta hai?

text.en: A fixed date, such as exactly six weeks
text.ur: Muqarrar tareekh, maslan theek chhe haftay

feedback.ur: Khawateen mukhtalif raftar se theek hoti hain.

text.en: Readiness: no leaking, heaviness or pain, good strength and control
text.ur: Taiyari: leaking, bojh ya dard nahi, achhi taaqat aur control

feedback.en: Yes — readiness is more important than a fixed date.
feedback.ur: Haan — taiyari muqarrar tareekh se zyada ahem hai.

title.en: Early postnatal weeks or three months and beyond?
title.ur: Shuruati postnatal haftay ya teen mahine aur uske baad?

rows.en: Short walks, gentle exercises, no heavy lifting
rows.ur: Chhote chakkar, halki exercises, bhaari uthana nahi

rows.en: Progressive strength, run-walk intervals if ready
rows.ur: Darje war taaqat, taiyar ho to run-walk intervals

rows.en: Heavy bleeding, pain, fever, calf pain
rows.ur: Bhari bleeding, dard, bukhar, pindli ka dard
Leaking, bojh, dard, pait ka ubhaar

rows.en: Rest, sleep and help at home
rows.ur: Aaram, neend aur ghar mein madad
Taaqat ka plan, pelvic floor ka review

text.en: **Walk, strengthen, then run.** Start with walking and the pelvic floor, build strength over weeks, then test with hops and run-walk intervals. If symptoms appear, step back and review.
text.ur: **Chalein, mazboot karein, phir daurein.** Chalne aur pelvic floor se shuru karein, haftoon mein taaqat banayein, phir hops aur run-walk intervals se test karein. Alamaat aayen to ek qadam peechay jayein aur review karein.

text.en: **Telling every woman to avoid exercise until six weeks, or to do sit-ups to "close the gap".** Early gentle movement is safe and helpful. Crunches do not reliably close an abdominal gap, and a width alone does not predict problems. Focus on function: control, strength and symptoms.
text.ur: **Har aurat ko chhe haftay tak exercise se bachne ko kehna, ya "gap band karne" ke liye sit-ups.** Jaldi halki harkat mehfooz aur mufeed hai. Crunches pait ke gap ko bharosemand tareeqe se band nahi karte, aur sirf chaurai masle ki peshgoi nahi karti. Function par tawajjo dein: control, taaqat aur alamaat.

question.en: A mother 10 weeks after birth wants to run but leaks urine when she coughs. What is best?
question.ur: Paidaish ke 10 haftay baad maa daurna chahti hai magar khansne par peshab nikalta hai. Behtareen kya hai?

text.en: Tell her to stop exercising entirely
text.ur: Exercise mukammal band karne ko kahein

feedback.ur: Halki taaqat ka kaam mufeed hai.

text.en: Build pelvic floor and leg strength first, delay running and review with a plan
text.ur: Pehle pelvic floor aur taangon ki taaqat banayein, daurna der se shuru karein aur plan ke saath review karein

feedback.en: Yes — leaking means she is not yet ready for impact.
feedback.ur: Haan — leaking ka matlab hai woh abhi impact ke liye taiyar nahi.

text.en: Start running to strengthen the pelvic floor
text.ur: Pelvic floor mazboot karne ke liye daurna shuru karein

feedback.en: Impact on a weak floor can worsen leaking.
feedback.ur: Kamzor floor par impact leaking barha sakta hai.

question.en: Which sign needs medical review in the early weeks after birth?
question.ur: Paidaish ke shuruati haftoon mein kaun si nishani medical review maangti hai?

text.en: Mild tiredness after a short walk
text.ur: Chhote chakkar ke baad halki thakan

text.en: Light bleeding that is slowly reducing
text.ur: Halki bleeding jo aahista kam ho rahi hai

feedback.en: That is part of normal recovery.
feedback.ur: Yeh normal recovery ka hissa hai.

text.en: Heavy or foul-smelling bleeding, fever, or a hot swollen calf
text.ur: Bhari ya badboodar bleeding, bukhar, ya garam soojhi hui pindli

feedback.en: Yes — these can signal infection or a clot.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh infection ya clot ki nishani ho sakti hain.

text.en: **Meet her where she is.** Ask about sleep, support and feeding, and plan around nap times. Offer two or three short sessions a week rather than one long class. Respect her goals, whether it is carrying the baby comfortably, returning to the gym or running again, and review every few weeks.
text.ur: **Jahan woh hai wahan se shuru karein.** Neend, madad aur doodh pilane ke baare mein poochhein, aur sone ke waqt ke mutabiq plan banayein. Ek lambi class ke bajaye haftay mein do teen chhote sessions dein. Uske maqasid ka ehtiram karein, chahe bachay ko aaram se uthana ho, gym wapas jana ho ya dobara daurna, aur har kuch haftay review karein.

question.en: Why can an abdominal gap be present without symptoms?
question.ur: Pait ka gap alamaat ke baghair kyun ho sakta hai?

answer.en: The midline connective tissue stretches during pregnancy, so a gap is common in the early months and often narrows by itself. What matters for function is whether the abdominal wall can generate tension and control the trunk during load, not only the width of the gap.
answer.ur: Hamal mein midline ka connective tissue khichta hai, is liye shuruati mahino mein gap aam hai aur aksar khud kam ho jata hai. Function ke liye ahem yeh hai ke pait ki deewar load ke dauran tension paida kar sake aur trunk ko control kar sake, sirf gap ki chaurai nahi.

beats.patient: A woman three months after a vaginal birth wants to start running. She has no pain, but leaks a little when she hops, and feels heaviness by the evening. Her abdominal midline shows a small gap that does not dome with effort.
beats.assessment: Leaking and heaviness on impact show she is not yet ready to run, while the abdominal wall is functioning well.
beats.treatment: Continue strength training, add pelvic floor work, delay running and retest hops in four weeks.
beats.reassess: At four weeks she hops without leaking and starts a run-walk plan.

text.en: **Seek medical review** for heavy or foul-smelling bleeding, fever, severe pain, a hot swollen calf, chest pain or breathlessness, a bulge in the vagina, an opening or discharge from a caesarean scar, low mood that does not lift or thoughts of harming herself or the baby. Perinatal mental health problems are common and treatable.
text.ur: **Medical review karwayein** bhari ya badboodar bleeding, bukhar, shadeed dard, garam soojhi hui pindli, seene ka dard ya saans ki tangi, vagina mein ubhaar, caesarean scar ka khulna ya paani, ya aisi udaasi jo na jaye ya khud ko ya bachay ko nuqsan pahunchane ke khayalat. Paidaish ke baad zehni sehat ke masle aam aur qabil-e-ilaaj hain.

summary.en: Start gentle movement soon after birth; return to impact depends on readiness (no leaking, heaviness or pain), not on a fixed date.
summary.ur: Paidaish ke jaldi baad halki harkat shuru karein; impact par wapsi taiyari (leaking, bojh ya dard nahi) par munhasir hai, muqarrar tareekh par nahi.

summary.en: Build pelvic floor and strength in stages, and test hops and run-walk intervals before running; an abdominal gap is common and often narrows.
summary.ur: Pelvic floor aur taaqat marhalon mein banayein, aur daurne se pehle hops aur run-walk intervals test karein; pait ka gap aam hai aur aksar kam ho jata hai.

summary.en: Watch for bleeding, fever, calf pain, a bulge or low mood and refer promptly.
summary.ur: Bleeding, bukhar, pindli ka dard, ubhaar ya udaasi par nazar rakhein aur jald refer karein.

front.en: What decides return to running after birth?
front.ur: Paidaish ke baad daurna kab shuru ho yeh kya tay karta hai?

back.en: Readiness: no leaking, heaviness or pain, with good strength.
back.ur: Taiyari: leaking, bojh ya dard nahi, achhi taaqat ke saath.

front.en: Is an abdominal gap always a problem?
front.ur: Kya pait ka gap hamesha masla hai?

back.en: No, it is common and often narrows; function matters more.
back.ur: Nahi, aam hai aur aksar kam ho jata hai; function zyada ahem hai.

front.en: What is a safe early activity?

back.en: Walking, breathing and gentle pelvic floor work.
back.ur: Chalna, saans aur halka pelvic floor ka kaam.

front.en: Name one sign needing medical review.
front.ur: Medical review ki ek nishani batayein.

back.en: Heavy or foul-smelling bleeding, fever or a hot swollen calf.
back.ur: Bhari ya badboodar bleeding, bukhar ya garam soojhi pindli.

note.ur: Pelvic floor ko sahi tareeqe se train karein.
